# Pull Request

## Related issue
Fixes https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/5073

## What does this PR do?
- Introduce utoipa and the auto-generation of the openAPI file
- Introduce the scalar swagger when the `swagger` feature flag is enabled.

Generating the openAPI file takes between 15 and 20ms at startup time on my computer. That could be an issue if we plan to stabilize the feature.

issue_context.title: Update Open API file for v1.13.0
issue_context.body:
This issue is about updating the [Open API file](https://github.com/meilisearch/open-api/blob/main/open-api.yaml) related to the Meilisearch release.

## How?

Open a PR on [this repository](https://github.com/meilisearch/open-api) to update the `open-api.yaml` file reflecting changes that have been implemented for the current release.

## When?

⚠️ This should be done at the end of the sprint, once all the implementations have been done.
comments: Is it normal it's close @irevoire? I would rather close https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/4871?
I re-open, feel free to close if I was wrong

review_comments: can you elaborate as a response to this comment why the intermediate struct is needed?

Yes!
It's the very bad part of utoipa.
I didn't find any solution to this problem, yet I should open an issue on utoipa.

-----

The issue is that I didn't find any way to implement `ToSchema` for the `Setting` enum of milli.
That's generally not an issue, we can override the type of the `Setting` with the `value_type` parameter but in this specific case.
Since this type is used in the settings route, directly and through the macro that auto-generate all the settings route, I can't remap the `value_type` :weary: 

So, I found this non-ideal solution of defining a `transparent` type that remap the `value_type`.

It's the only problematic type.
